ai.title: Bold ad CTA and clickable domain in CLI banner
ai.summary: AdBanner CTA text now renders bold via `TextAttributes.BOLD` and domain text becomes an interactive `Button` with underline styling. This increases visual prominence and expands the click target for the ad link in the CLI. Scoped to `cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx`. Domain click behavior now mirrors CTA hover states and actions.

eli5.text: When you run the command-line tool, the promotional banner now shows the call-to-action text in bold, making it stand out more clearly. The web address shown next to it is now also clickable, so you can jump straight to the advertised site instead of just seeing it as plain text. Both elements respond visually when you hover over them, so it feels more interactive.

ai.title: Release 1.0.620: CLI banner, grok-4.1-fast, and free build button
ai.summary: Version 1.0.620 ships three user-facing improvements across Freebuff's CLI surface. The CLI ad banner (`cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx`) now renders the CTA in bold and makes the domain a clickable underlined button. commander-lite's free agent model in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts` swaps from `minimax/minimax-m2.5` to `x-ai/grok-4.1-fast`. A new 'Build FREE' button in CLI plan mode propagates an `onBuildFree` callback through `chat.tsx`, `use-chat-input.ts`, and the rendering block tree. Additional context: pricing tooltip clarifies mode scope and a Gravity API ad relevancy parameter of 0.3 was added to the web API handler.
ai.evidence: Diff hunk shows `cli/release/package.json` version changed from 1.0.619 to 1.0.620 in `@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@` block modifying the `version` field at line 3. Analysis notes confirm this is a release-bump commit (1a7b57c8) following the Bold ad CTA update (aed5699d) and preceding the subscriber profitability script (7ea760f0).

eli5.text: This release rolls out a faster, more capable AI model for free users, a new one-click Build FREE button in the CLI planning mode, and a clearer pricing tooltip that explains your usage limits, plus a bolded and more clickable ad banner in the CLI. The free commander-lite mode now runs on the upgraded grok-4.1-fast model, giving faster command execution when using free tier access. Users can now trigger a free build action directly from the rendered plan blocks in the CLI interface, making it quicker to get started without leaving the plan view. The pricing page now clearly states that subscribing unlocks all modes with higher weekly limits, with a tooltip explaining the 5-hour session caps, and the ad banner in the terminal has a bolder call-to-action and a clickable domain link for easier navigation. Upgrading gives you faster free-tier performance, a more streamlined way to start a free build from your plan, clearer understanding of your usage limits, and a better overall CLI and pricing experience.

ai.title: Add script to analyze subscriber profitability
ai.summary: New internal script scripts/analyze-subscriber-profitability.ts computes projected profit per subscription tier. Queries active subscriptions and credit_ledger usage, normalizing to weekly/monthly rates using PROFIT_MARGIN and SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS. Excludes hardcoded internal emails. Outputs tier summaries, per-subscriber breakdowns, and overall net profit to console.

eli5.text: A new behind-the-scenes tool now lets the team see how much money each subscription tier makes compared to how much it costs to serve. It runs only inside the company, not something you'd see, and it skips one specific internal email address. The numbers are printed to the team's console, not to the app, so nothing changes for subscribers today.
